source: Six previously exposed author-written questions; not new official gold or an independent test

pilot.claim_text: Carbon dioxide absorbs infrared radiation and ocean acidity increases with carbon dioxide.
Sea level rise can result from both thermal expansion and melting land ice.
Atmospheric carbon dioxide was exactly 800 ppm in 2010.
The greenhouse effect depends on infrared radiation, not just incoming sunlight.

predeclared_checks.schema: Separate valid-attempt fraction, eventual legal action and mechanically accepted answer
predeclared_checks.agency: A valid model tool action followed by a completed tool event, changed/unchanged feedback and another model action; no scripted selection
predeclared_checks.retrieval: Candidate and context deltas are descriptive; no official gold in this pilot
predeclared_checks.support: Exact quote checks are not entailment; qualitative review is not blind human annotation
predeclared_checks.accounting: Every failed and repaired generation counts against the same five-call budget; fixed routes have the same upper limit, report actual work separately
predeclared_checks.promotion: No generalization or deployment claim; hand off before a separately reviewed grouped external experiment
